## Service divisions
- [Website development & e-commerce](https://jayant-systems.online/services/websites-ecommerce): We design and develop modern, responsive websites that help businesses establish credibility, attract customers and generate enquiries.
- [Custom software & business systems](https://jayant-systems.online/services/custom-software): We build applications and internal systems around how your business actually operates, helping you replace fragmented tools and manual processes.
- [AI integrations & workflow automation](https://jayant-systems.online/services/ai-automation): We integrate artificial intelligence and automation into everyday business operations, helping teams reduce manual tasks and simplify existing workflows.
- [UI/UX, design & branding](https://jayant-systems.online/services/design-branding): We create consistent, purposeful visual experiences that communicate your brand clearly and make your digital products easier to use.
- [SEO, digital growth & ongoing support](https://jayant-systems.online/services/seo-growth-support): We help businesses maintain, improve and optimise their digital presence through search optimisation, analytics and ongoing technical support.

- [Website development](https://jayant-systems.online/services/website-development): Business websites, redesigns, landing pages and e-commerce stores, built responsive, fast and easy to update. Jayant Systems.

- [API development & integration](https://jayant-systems.online/services/api-development): REST APIs, payment gateway, CRM, email and WhatsApp integrations that connect your existing tools. Jayant Systems.
- [Mobile app development](https://jayant-systems.online/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile-first web apps and cross-platform applications for customers and teams. Jayant Systems.
- [AI development](https://jayant-systems.online/services/ai-development): Custom AI agents, knowledge assistants and AI features connected to your data and tools. Jayant Systems.
- [AI chatbot development](https://jayant-systems.online/services/ai-chatbot-development): Website and WhatsApp AI assistants trained on your approved content, with human hand-off. Jayant Systems.
- [Business automation](https://jayant-systems.online/services/business-automation): Workflow, lead, email, WhatsApp and CRM automation that removes repetitive manual work. Jayant Systems.
- [Technology consulting](https://jayant-systems.online/services/technology-consulting): Technical audits, AI strategy, workflow analysis and technical planning before you invest. Jayant Systems.
- [UI/UX design](https://jayant-systems.online/services/ui-ux-design): UX journeys, UI design, prototypes and design systems for websites and apps. Jayant Systems.

## Commercial terms
- Every project starts with a defined quotation and agreed deliverables.
- Ownership, source-code access and licences are defined in the project agreement.
- Hosting, subscriptions and third-party costs are disclosed separately.
- No guaranteed revenue, rankings, unlimited revisions, lifetime support or 100% uptime.
- Project-based development: From ₹40,000
- Monthly digital partnership: From ₹2,999 / month
- Startup & MVP partnership: Quoted after a scoping call
- Technology consulting: Quoted after a scoping call
- End-to-end digital partnership: Quoted after a scoping call
